Both profiles retain the same complete original input tree and tracked path/mode/blob digest; the recorded Cargo package/bin selection changes the reachable application. The hello-world source preserves its original async index and source closure. The nested sample preserves all eight source callbacks through its original ServiceConfig helper, library crate, nested scopes and resource builders. Empty resource paths match their scope roots; slash routes stay separate. Native 404/405 contracts retain resource-before-route dispatch. The original Actix main attribute, literal log 0.4 message and default Actix Logger have narrow reviewed syntax contracts. Other macros, format operands, custom logging clauses, middleware and guards retain gaps.

Only tracked original Rust/Cargo/lock/ignore/config inputs are copied. Tracked Rust symlinks retain their original link payload and remain unread by the indexer. No Cargo/rustc, target code, compiler inference, dependency, build script, configuration or macro executes. Native Handler/Future/extractor/compiler validity and runtime serving are source contracts rather than executed checks. The Rust syntax fix for a tail async expression-statement wrapper keeps its original closure parent and prevents self-containment on this unselected source portfolio.

Axum 0.7 and 0.8 contracts have focused conformance and installed CLI/API/source/request-flow checks, including original callbacks, nest/merge/fallback/layers, raw URI syntax, HEAD behavior and path-before-method dispatch. Native behavior is checked against pinned Axum 0.7.9, Axum 0.8.9 and Actix Web 4.15.0 source and official dispatch documentation. These two unchanged-source profiles qualify Actix integration; they do not establish Axum source recall, broad version/target/platform coverage, compiler/runtime correctness or performance. Those checks remain P9e/P10; Rocket/Warp remains P9d.

Reproduce from the exact clean checkout: node scripts/qualify-rust-router-sources.mjs --actix-examples /path/to/actix-examples. Roadmap · P9a/P9b source portfolio.
